title: WindowControls: the column of elements starts below the texts of the renderer, top= sets it
author: Claude-JG
description: WindowControls placed the elements without location from the top of the window, over the texts which the renderer writes at the top left corner. Decided: the column starts at 0.25 of the window height, the argument top sets it; renderWindowControls.py uses it.
releaseNotes: exudyn.interactive.WindowControls places the elements without location below the texts of the renderer, from 0.25 of the window height; the argument top sets the upper edge of the column.
